question: What is the maximum time gap between two successive sessions of the Parliament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6 months**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Constitution of India mandates that the maximum time gap between two consecutive sessions of Parliament cannot exceed six months.
